create_SafeShellConfig: create a SafeShellConfig with repo_root path and AgentRole to configure safe shell execution
run_SafeShell_commands: run safe shell commands like cat, grep, find, and sort through SafeShell.run method
test_SafeShell_pipes: test SafeShell pipe support by chaining commands like cat file | grep pattern | wc -l
test_SafeShell_roles: test SafeShell role-based access control using READER, WORKER, and MERGER AgentRole values
format_ShellResult_for_agent: format a ShellResult using format_for_agent to get agent-friendly output with exit codes and stderr
